add.title: Add stock
add.intro: Record what you have just brought home. Pick the product, say how much it is and, if you like, when it expires and where you put it.
add.productSelectHint: Choose the product you want to add stock to.
add.noProducts: No product matches your search. Try different words, or create the product first.
add.quantityHint: How much you are adding, in the unit below. For example: 2.
add.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
add.expirationHint: Leave this blank if the product does not expire.
add.locationHint: Where you keep it, for example the fridge or the pantry.
add.notePlaceholder: For example: it was on offer
add.errorTitle: The stock could not be added
add.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
add.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
add.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
add.errorExpirationInvalid: That expiry date is not valid. Use the date picker.
add.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
add.errorLocationNotFound: That location no longer exists. Choose another one, or leave it without a location.
add.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before adding stock.
add.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.

consume.title: Consume stock
consume.intro: Record what has been used up. Pick the product, see how much is left and say how much you used.
consume.availableNoProduct: Choose a product to see how much is left.
consume.availableUnknown: We could not check how much is left. You can carry on, but check the amount before you save.
consume.quantityHint: How much you used, in the unit below. It cannot be more than what is left.
consume.unitHint: How it is measured. For example: kg, L, pack.
consume.locationHint: Where you took it from, for example the fridge or the pantry.
consume.errorTitle: The consumption could not be recorded
consume.errorProductRequired: Choose a product from the list.
consume.errorQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
consume.errorUnitRequired: Enter the unit, for example kg or pack.
consume.errorNotEnoughStock: There is not that much. Only {available} {unit} of this product are left. Enter that amount or less, or add stock first.
consume.errorNotEnoughStockServer: There is no longer enough of this product: someone in your household used it while you were filling in the form. Go back to the inventory to see what is left, then try a smaller amount.
consume.errorProductNotFound: That product no longer exists. Pick another one from the list.
consume.errorNoHousehold: Your account does not belong to a household yet. Create one or ask to be invited before consuming stock.
consume.errorGeneric: We could not save it. Check the details and try again; if it keeps failing, try again in a few minutes.
